readings.analytic_madds: RULED (section 22 M6): analytic multiply-adds are those of one whole training update including the frozen backbone's forward and backward pass (formula in the config, checked against a FLOP count by a test) plus 4 x trainable parameters for AdamW
readings.dense_efficiency: RULED (section 22 (k), m3): a FASTER STEP with no D-OQ cell prints DENSE NOT READ, one whose dense-speed comparison is undecided from the bounds prints DENSE SPEED UNDECIDED; neither blocks
readings.dense_not_established: RULED (section 22 M5): where the dense matched-compute pair is MC-SHORT or MC-AMBIGUOUS the label is DENSE NOT ESTABLISHED AT MATCHED COMPUTE (<status>), never DENSE MATCHES; the matched-updates comparison with D-OQ is printed beside it, descriptively; as designed S1 cannot show that the store beats or matches a dense map at matched compute at 65,536 slots
readings.dense_rate_tie: RULED (section 22 M7): among dense rates within 0.02 at the selection readout, the faster learner (a_use at U_P/2, U_P/4, down to U_P/16; the first difference of at least 0.02 decides), else the smaller learning rate
readings.dep_reads: RULED (section 22 (g)): DEP is read at every snapshot up to the run length, of both cells
readings.knn_information: READING: i of KNN-W, KNN-W-IVF and DICT is computed from raw accuracy (there is no memory to swap)
readings.mc_direction: the costlier cell of a pair is read at U_P and the cheaper at the smallest snapshot of the MC grid whose cumulative cost is at least that; where the two cost measures give different costlier cells (MC-AMBIGUOUS, revision 5, section 5.4) the cell whose advantage would be claimed is read at U_P and the other at the smallest grid snapshot with multiplier at least the larger of r and 1/r: the pair counts as established, with the annotation, or is MC-SHORT
readings.mc_snapshot_grid: READING: a multiplier above 6 has no snapshot on the MC grid and is MC-SHORT
readings.movement: READING: the row-movement ratio printed with a verdict is the larger cell's total value-row movement over the smaller's at U_P, with the without-gradient share ratio beside it; OPTIMIZER-ASSISTED tests the share ratio; efficiency verdicts also print both at each cell's hit snapshot
readings.panels: RULED (ADR-0021 section 22 (h)): for a label that favours the store (TREE_AHEAD, TREE_COMPETITIVE and every positive condition) a replicate counts only if both panels satisfy it; for a label that blocks (DENSE AHEAD, DENSE FASTER) a replicate counts if either panel satisfies it; PANEL-DISAGREE is the verdict when the panels give different verdicts
readings.robustness: RULED (section 22 (n)): robustness is read on Panel A and printed for both panels, accuracy retained = mean raw accuracy over three seeded masks; descriptive
readings.seed_block_readouts: RULED (section 22 (m)): the seed block's spread is reported at U_P and U_run; descriptive
readings.simulation_setting: RATIFIED (section 22 (c)): page misses at 8 rows per page, rho = 1/4, ascending tie rule; descriptive, enters no rule
